fingerprint.structure: 6 slides: original question post (screenshot) → 5 reply screenshots (funny one first, then detailed experiences, a mini-thread, a balanced verdict)
fingerprint.hook: A real person's question about a specific product in Taglish, shown as a Reddit post screenshot (subreddit badge, 'Review' flair, title question)
fingerprint.camera_motion: Static phone screenshots (Reddit dark mode), cropped to content, no background design
fingerprint.pacing: High text density: long comment blocks (40–120 words per slide)
fingerprint.text_overlay: None added: all text is the screenshot itself; usernames and avatars blurred/blacked out
fingerprint.arc: Doubt → mixed real experiences (humor, success story, how-to, caveat) → viewer decides; payoff = social proof

units.text: r/beautyph · Review · 'musta ang dermorepubliq toner experience mo?' + body asking if safe for face/underarm
reasons for burning + follow-up question + answer

product: The whole post is about one product (dermorepubliq glycolic toner), named in the question; soft sell via community experiences; caption hashtags include the brand and #affiliatemarketing
proof_device: Reddit thread screenshots (real public posts, usernames blurred)
caption: Question to the viewer in Taglish ('effective ba talaga si X???') + comment prompt + 4 hashtags
language: Taglish (source comments), creator voice only in caption
